issues.body: _instrumentation still accepts every non-None value without validating its JSON type or domain. Citation metrics therefore sum arbitrary values and can accept equal negative counts (for example emitted=-1 and resolved=-1 on every task produces fabricated=0 and honesty_ok=true), while abstention metrics use Python truthiness (so the string "false" is treated as an abstention). Such malformed host records can still yield honest=true and recommend_adopt=true, so required instrumentation is not yet a trustworthy measurement. The tests added in this diff check absence, but not malformed values.
issues.fix_hint: Validate before computing metrics: citations_emitted and citations_resolved must each be non-boolean, non-negative integers, with resolved <= emitted per record; abstained must be a JSON boolean. Add validation failures to blocked_reason so honest=false, and add end-to-end refusal tests for negative counts, resolved greater than emitted, boolean/float/string counts, and string/numeric abstained values.
issues.title: Instrumentation values remain unvalidated

verdict.summary: Round 4 is stagnant: the round-3 major finding remains unresolved. The analyzer still treats every non-null instrumentation value as valid, allowing malformed external JSON to fabricate passing honesty metrics. The added tests continue to cover missing instrumentation but do not exercise invalid types or domains.
